skills.trigger: When evaluating a right paratracheal mass or widening of the right paratracheal stripe on a chest X-ray.
steps: Inspect the right mediastinal border adjacent to the trachea for convexity, lobulation, or increased soft tissue density exceeding the normal thin stripe width.

Distinguish lymphadenopathy from cysts (e.g., bronchogenic, pericardial) by noting that lymphadenopathy typically presents as an irregular, lobulated, or asymmetric fullness often associated with systemic symptoms, whereas cysts usually appear as smooth, well-defined, water-density contours without associated parenchymal disease.
